title: imec NanoIC 試驗線架構
summary: 從試驗線目的、系統探索到里程碑核對：以 12 項工程決策、24 個模型與診斷工作包建立證據。
summaryEn: From Pilot-line purpose and System exploration to Milestone verification: build evidence through twelve engineering decisions and twenty-four modeling/diagnostic work packages.
scope: 公開原理的教學拆解：12 個技術主題各有模型／分析及故障／驗證兩步，共四階段 24 步。不是 24 道實際製造配方，也不是任何廠商量產流程。數值由學員自訂並標示為假設；涉及材料加工、高壓、雷射或化學品的活動僅做圖上與資料分析，不由網頁授權實機操作。
scopeEn: A public-principles educational decomposition: twelve technical topics each have a model/analysis step and a diagnosis/verification step, organized as four stages and twenty-four work packages. These are not twenty-four fabrication recipes or a manufacturer flow. Learner-selected numbers are hypothetical; materials processing, high voltage, lasers and chemicals are studied through diagrams/data, not authorized physical operation.

stages.title: 試驗線目的 → 技術模組
stages.description: 把「試驗線目的」「跨國節點」「技術模組」各拆成模型與診斷兩項工作，保留可檢查成果。
stages.descriptionEn: Develop model and diagnostic deliverables for Pilot-line purpose, Distributed nodes, Technology modules.

steps.title: 試驗線目的：建立模型
steps.objective: 用可檢查的成果說明「試驗線用於技術驗證，與量產工廠目標不同」。
steps.objectiveEn: Demonstrate the following with inspectable work: Pilot lines validate technology and differ from volume-fab objectives.
steps.instruction: 畫研究假說、試片、學習迴圈與量產移轉四個功能。先標出輸入、輸出與適用假設；依圖形、計算或比較表完成推理；把估算、來源事實與待量測項分開。所有自行設定數值均標為教學假設。
steps.instructionEn: Draw hypothesis, test vehicle, learning cycle and production-transfer functions. Mark inputs, outputs and assumptions; complete the diagram, calculation or comparison; separate estimates, source facts and measurements still needed. Label all chosen values as hypothetical.
steps.observation: 試驗線用於技術驗證，與量產工廠目標不同；技術成功也需評估可移轉性。
steps.observationEn: Pilot lines validate technology and differ from volume-fab objectives; Technical success also needs transferability assessment.
steps.failure: 若採用「有最先進設備便等於產品已量產」，先回到前一步模型，檢查假設、量測條件及本步的診斷因素。
steps.failureEn: If using the claim "Equating advanced equipment with production-ready products", return to the model and check assumptions, measurement conditions and the diagnostic factor.
steps.check: 提交「試驗線目的」的圖表或計算、單位與至少一項假設；成果須能追溯到本步指定的輸入和輸出，並說明：試驗線用於技術驗證，與量產工廠目標不同。
steps.checkEn: Submit the Pilot-line purpose diagram/table or calculation with units and at least one assumption, tracing inputs to outputs and explaining: Pilot lines validate technology and differ from volume-fab objectives.

knowledge.text: 模型邊界：不可由目前成果直接推出「有最先進設備便等於產品已量產」。
knowledge.textEn: Model boundary: the current result does not establish the following claim: Equating advanced equipment with production-ready products.

knowledge.title: 任務延伸｜接班建模：先寫出不能推論的事
knowledge.titleEn: Mission extension | Shift intake: state what the evidence cannot prove
knowledge.text:
以「imec NanoIC 試驗線架構」為本次任務邊界，閱讀「試驗線目的：建立模型」後，先列出輸入、輸出與量測單位。特別檢查：試驗線公開能力不等於每個模組都有量產認證。將已知、模型假設與未量測項目分開，再進入「晶圓城夜班：來料、廠務與搬運」整合遊戲。

需留下的證據：任務邊界表：imec NanoIC 試驗線架構 的資料版本、單位、輸入／輸出及一項不能由現有證據支持的結論。

驗證與交接：能用自己的話解釋為何「試驗線公開能力不等於每個模組都有量產認證」，且沒有把猜測寫成實測。
knowledge.textEn:
Use imec NanoIC pilot-line architecture as the task boundary. After reading “Pilot-line purpose: construct and analyze”, list inputs, outputs and measurement units. Check specifically: Published pilot-line capability does not mean every module is production-qualified. Separate known data, model assumptions and unmeasured items before entering “Wafer City night shift: incoming material, utilities and logistics”.

Evidence to retain: Boundary sheet for imec NanoIC pilot-line architecture: data version, units, inputs/outputs and one unsupported conclusion.

Verification and handover: Explain why “Published pilot-line capability does not mean every module is production-qualified” and do not present assumptions as measurements.

quiz.question: 關於「試驗線目的」，哪項推論有物理依據？
quiz.questionEn: For Pilot-line purpose, which inference has a physical basis?
options: 試驗線用於技術驗證，與量產工廠目標不同
有最先進設備便等於產品已量產
所有合作工作都假設在同一無塵室
optionsEn: Pilot lines validate technology and differ from volume-fab objectives
Equating advanced equipment with production-ready products
Assuming all partner work happens in one cleanroom
quiz.explanation: 試驗線用於技術驗證，與量產工廠目標不同；錯誤主張的問題是未保留必要條件或機制。
quiz.explanationEn: Pilot lines validate technology and differ from volume-fab objectives. The competing claim omits a necessary condition or mechanism.

steps.title: 試驗線目的：故障判讀與驗證
steps.objective: 以新增對照檢查「有最先進設備便等於產品已量產」這項錯誤主張。
steps.objectiveEn: Test the faulty claim: Equating advanced equipment with production-ready products.
steps.instruction: 接續前一步「試驗線目的」成果，先指出錯誤主張「有最先進設備便等於產品已量產」漏掉哪個條件。新增診斷原理：技術成功也需評估可移轉性。據此設計一組正常與異常對照；指定可區分兩者的觀察量、取樣位置或時間；寫下證據不足時應保留的未決結論。不得虛構實測數字。
steps.instructionEn: Continue the preceding Pilot-line purpose artifact. Identify the missing condition in the faulty claim "Equating advanced equipment with production-ready products". Introduce this diagnostic principle: Technical success also needs transferability assessment. Design normal/fault controls; specify a distinguishing observable, sampling location or time; state what remains undecided without evidence. Do not fabricate measurements.
steps.observation: 試驗線用於技術驗證，與量產工廠目標不同；技術成功也需評估可移轉性。
steps.observationEn: Pilot lines validate technology and differ from volume-fab objectives; Technical success also needs transferability assessment.
steps.failure: 若採用「有最先進設備便等於產品已量產」，先回到前一步模型，檢查假設、量測條件及本步的診斷因素。
steps.failureEn: If using the claim "Equating advanced equipment with production-ready products", return to the model and check assumptions, measurement conditions and the diagnostic factor.
steps.check: 交出「試驗線目的」的正常／異常比較、可觀察量與一項仍未確定事項；必須解釋「技術成功也需評估可移轉性」如何改變前一步的判讀。
steps.checkEn: Submit a normal/fault comparison for Pilot-line purpose, its observable and one remaining uncertainty. Explain how "Technical success also needs transferability assessment" changes interpretation of the preceding artifact.

knowledge.title: 試驗線目的／驗證與限制
knowledge.text: 可證偽性：「有最先進設備便等於產品已量產」與「試驗線用於技術驗證，與量產工廠目標不同」不可混為同一推論；對照需能觀察兩者的差別。
